judgments.rationale: The source establishes disjunctive disqualifications ('or' before paragraph 5), meaning a person is disqualified if any single condition is met. The proposed revision alters the summary to require that 'all of the following are true' joined by 'and', which contradicts the source by requiring conjunctive satisfaction of every disqualifying criterion.

The draft claim summary already accurately expresses the requirement to deem qualified persons. Filling an empty action field alone without curing a defect or changing the substantive meaning is not a needed correction under the evaluation criteria.
